plan.summary: BRO-4623 part 10: Lucky Guy (2013) recouped its $3.6M capitalization after eight weeks (Playbill, TheaterMania, May 2, 2013) but was labeled Flop with recouped=false. Set Easy Winner, recouped, cited, and lock the designation.
steps: Easy Winner: a limited run that recouped quickly (eight weeks of performances).
Recoupment and capitalization cite the May 2, 2013 Playbill and TheaterMania reports; the existing NYT source stays.
humanReviewedDesignation locks the outcome against the daily classifier.
